note: Hand-curated fixed catalogue of commonplace metabolic and industrial enzymes. No sequence or structure-coordinate fields exist in this file by design, and none may be added — see docs/scope.md. Temperature windows are degrees Celsius, pH windows are pH units, both are rounded teaching-grade ranges. Cartoon geometry (radius, hydrophobic, exit) is invented for the toy's geometric model and is not measured data.
